summary.en: Pre-market focus centers on earnings expectations ahead of earnings season and broader macro positioning as markets digest Fed commentary. Asian market close showed modest gains while futures track cautiously upward.
summary.zh: 盘前焦点集中在财报季预期及宏观配置，市场消化美联储言论。亚洲收市表现温和，期货谨慎上行。

title.en: Wall Street futures gain on resilient Asian markets ahead of earnings surge
title.zh: 美股期指在业绩季前因亚洲市场稳健而上涨

impact.en: Futures track higher as Japan and Korea show strength; tech earnings season typically drives rotation into AI leaders and growth names with resilient fundamentals.
impact.zh: 日/韩表现强劲带动期指上行；科技财报季通常推动资金流向 AI 龙头及基本面稳健的成长股。

macroRisk.en: No - earnings-driven rally supported by fundamentals, not rate-sensitive positioning
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 业绩驱动上涨由基本面支持，非利率敏感配置

title.en: Oil stabilizes as Middle East tensions remain contained
title.zh: 油价因中东局势受控而企稳

impact.en: WTI/Brent consolidation limits immediate inflation repricing impact; oil companies see neutral sentiment while energy transition plays face structural headwinds.
impact.zh: WTI/布伦特盘整限制通胀重定价影响；油企情绪中性，能源转型概念面临结构性阻力。

macroRisk.en: Yes - geopolitical stability reduces inflation risk premium, easing pressure on 10Y yields and duration-sensitive names
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 地缘政治稳定降低通胀风险溢价，缓解对美债收益率及久期敏感标的压力

title.en: Semiconductor supply chain shows signs of recovery in Q4 demand forecasts
title.zh: 半导体供应链第四季度需求前景显示复苏迹象

impact.en: Design and fabless names gain as inventory levels normalize; equipment makers see order visibility improve, while memory sector watches consumer electronics refresh cycles.
impact.zh: 设计与无厂设计股因库存正常化而上涨；设备商订单能见度改善，内存股关注消费电子换机周期。

macroRisk.zh: 否 - 板块基本面驱动，非利率依赖

ai.en: AI leaders trade on strong earnings expectations; NVIDIA and AMD benefit from data center demand while smaller caps watch AI infrastructure spending.
ai.zh: AI 龙头基于强劲业绩预期交易；NVIDIA/AMD 受益于数据中心需求，小型股关注 AI 基础设施支出。

semiconductor.en: Mixed sector outlook; memory names gain on consumer refresh while logic chips wait for client demand recovery. Equipment makers remain supported by capex cycles.
semiconductor.zh: 板块分化；内存因消费电子换机上涨，逻辑芯片等待客户需求复苏。设备商受资本支出周期支撑。

bigTech.en: Magnificent Seven show defensive positioning ahead of earnings; cloud revenue growth and AI monetization remain key valuation drivers.
bigTech.zh: 七巨头在财报前采取防御姿态；云收入增长和 AI 变现仍是估值关键驱动。

energy.en: Oil stabilizes amid geopolitical calm; refiners face margin pressure while upstream producers trade rangebound. Renewable plays lag on valuation concerns.
energy.zh: 地缘政治平静下油价企稳；炼油厂面临利润率压力，上游生产商区间震荡。可再生概念因估值担忧而落后。

ev.en: EV sector under pressure from broader auto cycle weakness and charging infrastructure delays. Battery names consolidate after earnings disappointments.
ev.zh: 电动车板块受汽车周期疲软及充电基础设施延误压制。电池股在业绩不及预期后盘整。

market.en: S&P 500 futures up modestly ahead of open; breadth neutral with sector divergence on earnings. Nasdaq shows strength in tech names while Dow lags.
market.zh: 标普期货小幅上涨；广度中性，板块因业绩分歧。纳斯达克科技股强势，道指落后。

preciousMetals.en: Gold and silver hold near recent highs on safe-haven flows from Middle East tensions; miners face margin compression from higher operating costs.
preciousMetals.zh: 金/银因地缘避险流持守近期高位；矿商面临高运营成本挤压利润率。

oil.en: WTI consolidates near $78-80 range; OPEC+ discipline holds while non-OPEC production increases supply. Prices support energy sector earnings but limit upside.
oil.zh: WTI 在$78-80 区间盘整；OPEC+纪律保持，非 OPEC 增产供应。油价支撑能源盈利但限制上行空间。

futures.en: S&P 500 futures +0.3%, Nasdaq futures +0.5%, Dow futures flat; Japan and Korea markets close higher providing modest Asian support.
futures.zh: 标普期指+0.3%，纳斯达克期指+0.5%，道指期货持平；日/韩上涨提供温和亚洲支撑。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y Treasury yield holds near 4.2%; stable with muted inflation data; rate-sensitive names see neutral positioning ahead of any CPI print.
treasury10Y.zh: 10Y 美债收益率持守 4.2% 附近；通胀数据平淡保持稳定；利率敏感标的在 CPI 公布前配置中性。

dxy.en: DXY tests key resistance levels; dollar strength pressures EM assets while multinational earnings supported by FX headwinds.
dxy.zh: 美元指数测试关键阻力位；美元强势压制新兴市场资产，但跨国公司业绩受汇兑逆风支持。

oil.en: WTI $79.50, Brent $83.20; consolidation pattern limits volatility; energy sector earnings remain supported but upside capped.
oil.zh: WTI $79.50，布伦特$83.20；盘整模式限制波动；能源盈利仍受支撑但上行受限。

keyRisk.en: Earnings surprise on major tech names could spark sector rotation; Middle East escalation would trigger safe-haven flows and inflation repricing.
keyRisk.zh: 重大科技股业绩意外可能引发板块轮动；中东局势升级将触发避险流和通胀重定价。

note.en: Mixed signals from earnings and macro; fundamentals support growth while rate stability allows duration extension. Watch for geopolitical escalation.
note.zh: 业绩和宏观发出混合信号；基本面支持成长，利率稳定允许久期延长。警惕地缘升级风险。
